content:
name: Story or Enabler
about: Refine a feature into an observable story or engineering enabler.
title: "[Story] "
body:
  - type: input
    id: identifier
    attributes:
      label: Story / enabler identifier
      placeholder: US-XXX or EN-XXX
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: parent
    attributes:
      label: Parent Feature
      placeholder: F-XXX-XX
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: input
    id: wp
    attributes:
      label: Governing Work Packet
      placeholder: WP-MVP-XXXX
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: acceptance
    attributes:
      label: Observable acceptance
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: boundaries
    attributes:
      label: Boundary / negative behavior
  - type: textarea
    id: verification
    attributes:
      label: Verification method
    validations:
      required: true
